correctionBoundary.repair: Fix only affected continuity groups to the selected exact approved candidate for both option comparison and adoption recheck. Resolve candidates before an old-performer recast changes its subject.
correctionBoundary.permission: The internal constraint filters current approved choices; it cannot grant approval. Missing or conflicting fixed identities fail closed. Physical diagnostic assignments are never exposed.
correctionBoundary.ordinaryAllocation: Unrestricted Schedule search still considers all admissible approved choices and retains its cost-first objective. Unrelated groups remain optimizable during repair assessment.
correctionBoundary.persistence: The constrained result is internal repair validation/findings, never installed as the ordinary allocationResult or presented as a global optimum.
correctionBoundary.compatibility: No public API, stored-production format, schema migration, environment or provider-fixture change.
